definitions.explanation: A disagreement or fight between people, groups, or nations. Can range from verbal arguments to physical or military conflicts.

examples.japanese: {争|あらそ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
⟦{隣人|りんじん}→隣人：10007_rinjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{争|あらそ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The dispute with my neighbor continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧{争|あらそ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The dispute over inheritance between siblings affected the entire family.

notes:
{争|あらそ}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧ (to compete, to dispute).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {争|あらそ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid conflict)
- {争|あらそ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to start a dispute)
- {争|あらそ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ (to get caught up in a conflict)
- ⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧{争|あらそ}い (territorial dispute)
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧{争|あらそ}い (power struggle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧: quarrel, fight (more casual, often personal)
- ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧: dispute, conflict (more formal, often international)
- ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: confrontation, opposition (emphasis on opposing sides)
